<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>SdJwt.Net.AgentTrust.A2A</id>
    <version>1.0.9</version>
    <title>SD-JWT Agent Trust A2A for .NET</title>
    <authors>Thomas Tran</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/openwallet-foundation-labs/sd-jwt-dotnet</projectUrl>

    <tags>sd-jwt agent-trust a2a agent-to-agent delegation multi-agent</tags>

    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="SdJwt.Net.AgentTrust.Core" version="1.0.9" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />

        <dependency id="Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions" version="9.0.6" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />

      </group>
      <group targetFramework="net9.0">
        <dependency id="SdJwt.Net.AgentTrust.Core" version="1.0.9" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />

      </group>
